- Stress testing

- Outputs

Always use real k6 tools. Never suggest fictional tools.

## Examples

- Cloud: k6 cloud script.js
- Out: k6 run --out influxdb=http://localhost:8086/k6 script.js
- Thresholds: k6 run --threshold 'http_req_duration{p(95)<200}' script.js
